messages:
laura: Heads-up: product asked for a more defensible preview for the routing-policy audit export. They want the preview to show representative diffs (not just the latest N events) and to surface why a field is considered sensitive.

niko: We should stratify samples by actor role + time-window + change-type. That avoids previews made of only low-risk noise. Idea: sample buckets like {admins, service-accounts, regular-users} and pick top changes per bucket.

emily: Good call. Also need to define "representative": UX wants to surface both unique diffs and frequency. Maybe preview shows a small heatmap line (count of similar diffs) next to each sampled row.

sana: Security: whatever we return in preview must carry metadata flags (pii:true, credential:true, redactible_fields:["email","ip"]). We can't allow arbitrary fields in preview to leak. Preview rows should be pre-redacted for anything marked pii by default, with a toggle to "show masked" for users with export permission.

laura: API proposal: POST /v1/audit/exports/preview {query, buckets:[], sample_per_bucket} -> {preview_id, samples_ndjson, bucket_counts, estimated_cost}. We'll also return a per-field sensitivity reason map. Example curl: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports/preview \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"query":"type:policy_change", "buckets":["admin","svc"], "sample_per_bucket":5}'

niko: Implementation nuance: sampling needs to be deterministic-ish for the same query/time range so preview and final export align. We can seed the sampler with a preview_id and time-range hash. Also store the seed in job metadata.

emily: Cost model discussion: product wants preview credits to be cheap (so teams try preview often) but not free. Suggest preview cost = max(1, ceil(estimated_bytes / 10MB)). Full export uses GB pricing. Make that visible in the preview modal.

sana: Add one more column in telemetry: "preview_shown_redacted_count" so we can see how often folks toggle to include sensitive fields. This will drive tighten/loosen defaults.

laura: Console UX: slide-over with columns [sample, similarity_count, sensitive_badges, redaction_toggle, reason]. Also add a small inline chart showing sample coverage across buckets. If user expands a row, show the raw diff with masked tokens highlighted.

niko: For the final commit we support: POST /v1/audit/exports/commit {preview_id, include_masked_fields:bool, redaction_policy: [fields->policy], output_format: "ndjson|zip"} -> returns export_job_id. We'll stream job updates via websocket/events.

emily: We should version export manifests. Include manifest_v, preview_id, seed, bundle_hash, signer_key_id, and retention_policy. Start with manifest_v=1 so we can change signing scheme later.

sana: On presigned links: default TTL 30m for regular exports, 15m for privileged tenant exports. All link creation must emit event export.link.created with actor and ip.

laura: Example of a preview sample row we'll return (sanitized NDJSON line):

{"event":"policy.change","actor":"admin@tenant.co","time":"2026-10-02T09:12:34Z","diff":"-allow /foo -> +deny /foo","sensitive_badges":["credential","ip"],"redactible_fields":["ip"],"similarity_count":12}

niko: Note: keep the preview payload strictly limited in size (max 100KB per preview). If a query would return a preview > that, return an error suggesting narrower time-range or more aggressive bucketing.

emily: UX decision: default redaction policy for previews = mask pii, hide credential fields. Users with legal/export roles can opt-in to reveal masked values in the preview. Always require an explicit checkbox on commit that they understand data sensitivity.

sana: Suggest adding "export.preview.used" and "export.commit.reason" telemetry fields. Also add a label for the policy query so we can tie back to product experiments.

laura: Action items: niko to prototype deterministic bucketed sampler (PR: branch preview-sampler), emily to mock slide-over with heatmap and toggle states, sana to draft telemetry events and security checklist, i'll write a one-pager for PM/legal.

infra-bot: ci/preview-sampler build started by niko (job #8991)

niko: ETA for prototype: end of week. I'll post PR and a small load estimate.

laura: Great — let's reconvene after the prototype. If prototype looks good we'll aim to ship preview+commit+manifest_v1 in next sprint. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
